name: The Books of Sorrow
description: The Hive's holy text and origin story, dictated by Oryx. It tells of three Krill sisters — Aurash, Sathona, and Xi Ro — who, dying on the gas giant Fundament, made a pact with the Worm Gods for power and immortality at the price of endless killing, becoming Auryx, Savathun, and Xivu Arath.

name: Unveiling
description: A lore book delivered by a Pyramid that frames the cosmic conflict from the Darkness's point of view, retelling the parable of the Gardener and the Winnower and arguing that the Darkness offers true freedom of self-determination.

name: Dredgen Yor
description: Once the noble Guardian Rezyl Azzir, he was corrupted by the Hive weapon that became the cursed hand cannon Thorn. As Dredgen Yor he murdered Guardians and civilians alike, including the young Jaren Ward, until Shin Malphur hunted him down at the Burning Lake.

name: Toland, the Shattered
description: A brilliant, obsessive Warlock who pursued forbidden Hive knowledge until he was cast out of the City. He followed the Sword Logic so far that he abandoned his body to exist as a will in the Ascendant Plane, where he still whispers guidance to those who hunt the Hive.

name: Ghost Fragment: The Last Array
description: Beneath the Cosmodrome lay the Array, a Golden Age communications site the Fallen House of Devils sought to seize. Reactivating it let the City hear the silent Warmind Rasputin stir for the first time since the Collapse.

name: The Sword of Crota
description: A blade of unimaginable power wielded by Crota, Son of Oryx, during the Great Disaster that consumed an entire Guardian army on the Moon. The cracked sword passed into legend until a Guardian reforged its like to strike Crota down.
